req.title: Create task
req.statement: The system shall create a new task and respond with HTTP 201 and the created task body when POST /tasks/ receives a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected_outcomes: response body includes id, title, completed=false

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that POST /tasks/ with a valid TaskCreate payload returns HTTP 201 and a body containing id, title, and completed=false. I designed: (1) a positive EP test with a fully valid payload including title and description, asserting exact status 201 and all response fields; (2) a negative NEG test with a missing required 'title' field, asserting exact 422 status; (3) a BVA boundary test with title at exactly 1 character (minimum allowed by min_length=1), asserting 201; (4) a BVA boundary test with title at exactly 100 characters (maximum allowed by max_length=100), asserting 201; (5) a BVA boundary test with title at 101 characters (one over max), asserting 422; (6) a DT test with completed=true explicitly set, asserting the field is stored as true; (7) a NEG test with an empty string title, asserting 422. These collectively kill mutations on status codes, field presence, boolean defaults, and boundary constants.

import sqlalchemy, os
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app import models
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

test_db_url = "sqlite:///./test_r_task_001_ep.db"
engine = create_engine(test_db_url, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    from app.database import SessionLocal as _SL
    db = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

from app.database import get_db
app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_payload_returns_201_with_body():
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries", "description": "Milk and eggs", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] > 0
    assert body["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert body["description"] == "Milk and eggs"
    assert "created_at" in body

test_create_task_valid_payload_returns_201_with_body()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
engine.dispose()
os.remove("./test_r_task_001_ep.db") if os.path.exists("./test_r_task_001_ep.db") else None
